commentary.text: 90+6' Mario Melero Lopez is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+4' Unai Lopez (Rayo Vallecano) gets a yellow card, off the field.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.

84' 2 - 1 Goal! Isi Palazon (Rayo Vallecano) weaves his way past opponents, and he unleashes a magnificent effort from the edge of the box into the top right corner. Sergio Herrera had no chance of reaching it. The score is 2:1.

82' Here comes a substitution. Moi Gomez is given a rest as he is replaced by Asier Osambela (Osasuna).

80' 1 - 1 The ball rebounds and arrives at the feet of Pep Chavarria (Rayo Vallecano) just outside the box. He doesn't think twice and fires a brilliant shot inside the right post. His attempt was beyond the reach of Sergio Herrera, so the score changes to 1:1.
80' The corner is swung in but Rayo Vallecano can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
